scope: Targeted token-input and consumer comparison, not novelty proof.

Existing upstream cross-attention acknowledged; utility/novelty unknown.

matches.hypothesis: Native query-language cross-attention computes a LayerNorm result but discards it before query self-attention. Its affine parameters therefore cannot learn language-conditioned query calibration. Reconnecting only the existing qla postnorm may remove residual common-mode/scale nuisance and restore a task-loss gradient path; this is a falsifiable implementation mechanism, not a promised accuracy improvement.
matches.matched_control: Frozen first64 distinct TRAIN scenes in dataset order, at most4 descriptions, seed1999, identical cached native decoder inputs and W2 checkpoint. Compare native/repeat/identity-return hook, existing qla LayerNorm reconnected, and unit-RMS-only normalization. First8 trained and first4 released-initialization native backward batches compare connected versus detached affine parameters at identical forward values. No padding/token subset, threshold, temperature, loss-weight or validation scan.

matches.hypothesis: Native semantic alignment includes masked language padding in query-to-token normalization, making training depend on nonexistent words. Excluding invalid tokens from the contrastive support should remove this nuisance gradient without changing valid annotation maps or inference.
matches.matched_control: Identical native train outputs, maps and lang_masks; fixed replacement of padding-only token projections versus repeat; actual native and support-masked semantic loss/gradients. No valid token removal, feature scan or weight tuning.

matches.hypothesis: Masked language-padding feature values may leak through the native decoder into query confidence, although they represent no words. Test actual decoder attention/aggregation, not the semantic-alignment loss denominator addressed by historical Y23. If all native confidence paths mask these positions and matched interventions have no effect beyond repeat noise, reject THIS leakage premise without creating a model variant.
matches.matched_control: Keep actual class, parameters, valid-language positions, 3D/query inputs and RNG fixed; compare padding-only feature replacement, an unchanged independent repeat, and a valid-token positive-control replacement. Audit every native path consuming lang_masks. Run exact native module controls first and a frozen TRAIN native-model/decoder-input capture if a task-relevant uncertainty remains. Do not tune mask thresholds, weights, temperature, sample or training epochs.

matches.hypothesis: Native mask features x_mask(x) are expression-independent before their dot product with language-conditioned queries. A direct valid-language-conditioned channel modulation of the shared mask features may make conditional mask fitting easier. Existing query cross-attention can represent language interactions; this is an architectural comparison, not a missing-information, novelty or efficacy claim.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus one mask-feature multiplication after native get_batches: f_next=f*(1+tanh(mean_valid(projected_language)@W)); W[256,256] exact zero/no RNG, +65536 parameters. Same modulated tensor feeds all seven native prediction heads. No change to shared confidence head, targets, losses, Boolean attention gate, selector, all-channel input, released SPFormer, seed1999, Q128 or fixed30 native YAML.

matches.hypothesis: The six existing query-language cross-attention outputs combine an incoming visual query with an attended-language update. A shared query-conditioned channel-wise gate on that existing update may ease fitting cross-modal updates. Native attention already depends on the query; no missing information, novelty or trained benefit is presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus q_after=q_language+tanh(q_visual@W)*(q_language-q_visual) immediately after each original qla output and before original qqa. W[256,256] is exactly zero without RNG (+65536). All six qla outputs and incoming q_visual tensors stay undetached; original qqa consumes the new tensor. Initial stage0, static mask features, original language padding, original discarded qla norm semantics, coarse/fine averaging/hard Boolean masks/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence calls/targets/losses/selector, full original inputs/existing2D/released backbone/Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML stay unchanged.

matches.hypothesis: Native sampling already uses language, while the sampled-seed query generator produces the initial query before later query-language refinement. A direct product interaction between the generated query and all valid projected language tokens pooled once may ease language-conditioned initial mask fitting. Native attention and sampling already encode language; missing information, novelty and efficacy are not presumed.
matches.matched_control: Unchanged W2 plus q_init=q_generated+(q_generated*mean_valid(original projected language))@W, once after original query generation and before the initial prediction. W[256,256] exactly zero/no RNG (+65536). Preserve original sampling indices/query positions, all valid tokens and native padding, static mask features, six original refinement stages, coarse/fine fusion/hard gates/SCG/k/gamma, seven shared confidence calls/targets/losses/selector, full input channels/existing2D/released SPFormer/Q128/seed1999/fixed30/native YAML. Original stage0 and all later predictions consume the initialized query; this is a direct initialization interaction, not a confidence-only readout.

matches.hypothesis: Native language states refine through language self-attention and visual cross-attention before providing query-language updates, without a direct current instance-query-set input. An added attention residual from all current queries into language states may ease iterative instance-aware language fitting. Existing visual/query paths can carry equivalent context; missing information, novelty and trained efficacy are not presumed.

matches.hypothesis: Original masks are a dot product between a normalized query and static visual features. A shared zero-initialized projection of squared normalized-query channels before only that dot product may ease nonlinear mask fitting. The query generator already represents nonlinear functions; no defect, missing information, novelty or benefit is presumed.
